newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PAKISTAN'S IJAZ AHMED FINED AFTER ALTERCATION.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN'S IJAZ AHMED FINED AFTER ALTERCATION.

text.p: Pakistan's Ijaz Ahmed has been fined 20 percent of his match fee for misbehaviour on the field after an altercation with the Sri Lankan captain on the first day of the second test in Colombo.

Cricket officials said on Sunday that match referee John Reid of New Zealand had also warned Ahmed that he would be barred from playing test cricket if he repeated the offence in the next five months.
Ahmed reportedly abused Arjuna Ranatunga as the Sri Lankan captain was walking off the field when he was dismissed for four runs off the bowling of Saqlain Mustaq on Saturday.
Reid later conducted an inquiry and imposed the fine on Ahmed, officials said.
Sri Lanka and Pakistan are playing the second and final test match in Colombo. The first test was drawn.
